review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC3670239, Infection-induced IL-10 and JAK-STAT
primary_title: IL-10-inducible Bcl-3 negatively regulates LPS-induced TNF-alpha production in macrophages
decision_basis: The reviews identify BCL3 as an IL-10/STAT3-inducible macrophage effector; the cited primary microarray and Bcl3-deficient macrophage assays establish IL-10-inducible Bcl3 expression and its anti-inflammatory function.
limitations_preserved: Gene-expression bridge distinct from the existing STAT3-to-BCL3 edge; preserve IL-10 plus LPS/macrophage context and do not infer BCL3 protein activity from transcription alone.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC2782488, Cytokine signaling modules in inflammatory responses
primary_title: Shaping gene expression in activated and resting primary macrophages by IL-10
decision_basis: The reviews identify SOCS3 as an IL-10-induced STAT3-dependent macrophage response gene; the cited primary microarray in IL-10-treated macrophages detects SOCS3 induction.
limitations_preserved: Gene output only; SOCS3 is induced by IL-10 but does not represent a direct IL-10R docking site or proof that SOCS3 terminates IL-10R signaling.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC1174965, Negative regulation of cytokine signaling and immune responses by SOCS proteins
primary_title: Suppressor of cytokine signaling 1 inhibits IL-10-mediated immune responses
decision_basis: The reviews describe IL-10-dependent SOCS1 induction; the cited primary shows IL-10-induced SOCS1 up-regulation across hematopoietic and fibroblast systems with dependence on IL-10R1/STAT3 signaling.
limitations_preserved: Gene output only; preserve the cross-cell-type and STAT3-dependence boundaries and do not infer a terminal transcription factor or universal feedback mechanism.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6211389, The Interferon Class of Cytokines and the IRF Transcription Factor Family; PMCID:PMC2774226, IFN-gamma receptor signaling
primary_title: Roles of IKK-beta, IRF1, and p65 in the activation of chemokine genes by interferon-gamma
decision_basis: The reviews describe IFN-gamma-induced IRF1 as a secondary STAT1-linked transcriptional response; the cited primary shows initial IFN-gamma/STAT1 activation drives IRF1 synthesis before IRF1-dependent chemokine transcription.
limitations_preserved: Gene induction bridge distinct from IFNGR→STAT1 and downstream IRF1 promoter occupancy; preserve the secondary IRF1-synthesis semantics and do not infer all IFN-gamma target genes from this row.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6211389, The Interferon Class of Cytokines and the IRF Transcription Factor Family; PMCID:PMC8607625, STAT proteins: a kaleidoscope of canonical and non-canonical functions in immunity and cancer
primary_title: Distinct modes of action applied by transcription factors STAT1 and IRF1 to initiate transcription of the IFN-gamma-inducible gbp2 gene
decision_basis: The reviews identify GBP2 as an IFN-gamma-responsive gene requiring STAT1 and IRF1 cooperation; the cited primary analyzes IFN-gamma-induced GBP2 transcription in wild-type, Stat1-deficient and Irf1-deficient cells.
limitations_preserved: Gene output only; preserve the joint STAT1/IRF1 requirement and do not flatten GBP2 transcription into direct IFNGR-to-GBP2 signaling.
